body:
Maria Ops: incoming EU top-off (30 A100s) — supplier just emailed a new AWB but flagged 3 units DOA at vendor QC. @Jordan can you confirm replacement SLA and whether we get loaners?
Jordan SCM: I saw the note. Contract SLA = 5 business days replacement. Vendor offered 48h express for extra cost. Need approval. Do we want loaners from regional pool?
Liam (VendorLogi): VendorLogi here — AWB LX123456789. Flagged damaged serials: A100-9876, A100-9877, A100-9878. We can split-ship replacements tomorrow AM via express, uplift +€4,200. Return AWB for DOA: RX333777.
Sophia CS: we have 2 customer jobs pinned to FRA region using these. If crossdock hold isn't applied we'll drop capacity for canary. Can we partial-release 27 and hold the 3?
Maria Ops: propose partial release: 27 -> staging-FRA, hold the 3 flagged units at crossdock. @Jordan please check loaner pool for 3 units for 72h. Budget-wise we can absorb the €4.2k if it's cheaper than SLA penalties.
Jordan SCM: checked loaners — only 1 A100 left in region, can't cover 3. Ops ok for expedite if finance signs off. @finance-bot can you confirm quick approval? cc @Sophia CS
finance-bot: finance-bot: expedited replacement cost < projected SLA penalty. Approve up to €5,000 for express replacements. Please submit cost center: INFRA-GPU-EXP.
Liam (VendorLogi): Roger — scheduling express pickup now, will send new AWB and tracking (expected to post: 1746643900). ETA replacements 48h. We'll include pre-paid RMA labels for returns (use RX333777).
Sophia CS: :thumbsup: I'll update the two impacted customers and mark jobs as at-risk until replacements arrive. Maria/Jordan — please confirm manifest when you release the 27.
Maria Ops: done — moving 27 units to staging and tagging hold on 3. Manifest snippet:
```
unit,serial,location,status
A100,A100-9801,staging-FRA,ready
A100,A100-9802,staging-FRA,ready
...
A100,A100-9876,crossdock-FRA,hold-damaged
A100,A100-9877,crossdock-FRA,hold-damaged
A100,A100-9878,crossdock-FRA,hold-damaged
```
Crossdock team instructed to not ship the 3 flagged units. Thread closed unless we see new info or tracking misses ETA. (Maria Ops reaction: :white_check_mark:)
